name: Specks backdrop
description: Soft glowing specks that rise slowly through a hero backdrop, each at its own depth, drawn on a small canvas.

propDocs.count: How many specks float at once. 0 to 200.
propDocs.colorDark: Speck colour in the dark theme. The dark theme blends specks with screen.
propDocs.colorLight: Speck colour in the light theme. The light theme draws them normally.
propDocs.parallax: How far the nearest specks slide with the pointer, in pixels. 0 turns the pointer drift off.

fallback: Nothing is drawn with reduced motion or without canvas: the hero keeps its picture and veil, which is what the original shows.
